To verify the anatomical correctness of the facial features, ear placement, and jaw structure during the open-mouth pose.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the fur, whisker rendering issues, or edge bleeding against the background.
To ensure sharp boundaries between the fur/whiskers and the background, checking for haloing or fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency around the ears and neck
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior of the mouth (tongue and teeth). AI generators often struggle with the complex geometry of an open mouth, potentially resulting in fused teeth or unnatural tongue textures. Also, inspect the whiskers for 'melting' into the background or inconsistent thickness.
